findings.message: When the magic __serialize() and __unserialize() methods are available and the code base does not need to support PHP < 7.4, the implementation of the Serializable interface can be removed. (the class also has __serialize()/__unserialize(), so PHP does not emit the Serializable deprecation)

'numeric' is a soft reserved keyword as of PHP version 7.0 and should not be used to name a class, interface, trait or enum or as part of a namespace (class declaration) (numeric has been a soft reserved name since PHP 7.0 and naming a class Numeric never raises an error, so nothing changes on newer PHP)

INI directive 'mbstring.func_overload' is deprecated since PHP 7.2 and removed since PHP 8.0 (ini_get()/ini_set() of a directive that no longer exists returns false without an error, and this directive was already gone before PHP 8.3, so the upgrade changes nothing)
